identity.tagline: Naturally leavened, by hand, in small batches

hero.headline: Naturally leavened, by hand
hero.sub: Country, seeded, and a cinnamon-raisin special each week, baked the night before

photo.prompt: A rustic round sourdough loaf, scored and blistered crust, on a wood board in warm light
photo.alt: A round sourdough loaf with a blistered crust

maker.label: Meet June
maker.headline: One oven, one pair of hands
maker.body: I started baking for neighbors and never stopped. Every loaf is mixed, folded, and shaped by hand the night before. I bake what I would want on my own table, and I sell it the morning it comes out.

photo.prompt: A baker in an apron holding a fresh loaf in a warm home kitchen
photo.alt: June holding a loaf in her kitchen

secondary.label: Where to find us
secondary.headline: Saturdays at the market
secondary.body: Find this week's bake at the Hope Street Farmers Market, 9 to 11am. Pre-orders are held until 10.

stayInTouch.headline: Get next week's bake list
stayInTouch.body: One email a week with the loaves and the pickup details.

footer.blurb: Baked and sold in Providence, Rhode Island
